en: Colorized vintage postcard view of a large Baroque church and monastery complex set on a hill in a rural, hilly landscape. The complex has red-tiled roofs, two tall twin towers with onion domes, and a central domed structure. Smaller surrounding buildings and paths lead through gardens and fields in the foreground. In the upper right corner, red printed text reads "Mariatrost bei Graz."
